lcc_original: 於是上帝造了地上各種走獸，各種牲口，和地上各種各樣的昆蟲：上帝看這很好。
notes: LCC restructures the first beast clause from UNV's 野獸<WH02416><WH0776> into 地上+走獸; WH0776 (הָאָרֶץ) is assigned to LCC's first 地上 and WH02416 to 走獸.
LCC uses 地上 twice but they map to two distinct Hebrew words: WH0776 (הָאָרֶץ, 'the earth/land') for the first beast group and WH0127 (הָאֲדָמָה, 'the ground/soil') for the creeping-things group.

In the third clause LCC's 各種各樣的 is a single compound phrase rendering both כָּל (WAH03605, 'all') and לְמִינֵהוּ (WAH09001+WH04327, 'according to its kind'); all three tags are attached to this phrase.

UNV has {<WAH03588>} (כִּי, complementizer 'that') implicit, but LCC's 這 provides a loose explicit equivalent; braces dropped per Rule 3, though the match is imperfect (demonstrative vs. conjunction).
